purpose: A reviewed registry of public source APIs that may be used to discover open-source repositories. Registry entries describe sources; they do not certify projects.

sources.name: GitHub public repositories
sources.authentication: Optional token for higher rate limits; never store tokens in catalogue data
sources.pagination: Use API pagination and stop at provider limits
constraints: Search results are relevance-ranked and incomplete
Search API has separate rate limits
Repository metadata is not a security or quality assessment

sources.name: GitLab public projects
sources.authentication: Public project discovery can use unauthenticated requests; never store tokens in catalogue data
sources.pagination: Use keyset or page pagination as documented and respect instance limits
constraints: Only public projects are in scope
Instance policies and rate limits apply
A project's visibility can change

sources.name: Codeberg public repositories
sources.authentication: Use public endpoints where available; never store tokens in catalogue data
sources.pagination: Follow the instance API pagination behavior and documented limits
constraints: Codeberg is one Forgejo host, not the whole Forgejo ecosystem
Do not assume every Forgejo instance permits anonymous discovery

sources.name: User-configured public Forgejo instances
sources.authentication: Public unauthenticated endpoints only; no credentials are sent to configured instances.
sources.pagination: Respect each host's documented limits and robots or acceptable-use policies
constraints: Only explicitly enabled HTTPS hosts in data/discovery-config.json are queried
API and repository URLs must use the same configured host
Hostnames must be public DNS names; local, loopback and IP-literal targets are rejected
Redirects are blocked; network-level egress controls are still recommended
Each host must be reviewed by a maintainer before enabling

sources.name: Gitea.com public repositories
sources.authentication: Public endpoints only; never store tokens in catalogue data
sources.pagination: Use documented page and limit parameters and respect instance rate limits
constraints: Only public repository metadata is in scope
Gitea.com is one host, not the entire Gitea ecosystem
Do not assume arbitrary Gitea instances permit anonymous discovery

sources.name: SourceHut public projects
sources.authentication: Do not send credentials. Anonymous public project discovery must be confirmed before enabling.
sources.pagination: Not configured; confirm official API pagination and rate-limit behavior first.
constraints: Not queried by the automated discovery workflow
Confirm current official API schema and anonymous public access before implementation
Do not scrape authenticated pages or bypass anti-abuse controls
SourceHut service status can change; a status page is not a repository discovery API

sources.name: npm public packages
sources.authentication: Public search and package metadata are read without credentials; never store tokens.
sources.pagination: Use bounded size/from offsets and conservative serial requests.
constraints: Search is relevance-ranked and not a complete export of npm.
Only packages with a valid public source repository URL on an approved host enter the repository review queue.
Registry publication does not establish source authenticity, quality or safety.

sources.name: crates.io public crates
sources.authentication: Public search metadata is read without credentials; never store tokens.
sources.pagination: Use bounded page/per_page parameters; respect crates.io data-access policy and identify the client.
constraints: Search is ranked and capped; it is not a complete export of all crates.
Only crates with a valid public source repository URL on an approved host enter the repository review queue.
Do not download or execute crate contents during discovery.

sources.name: RubyGems public packages
sources.authentication: Public search is available without credentials; never send API keys.
sources.pagination: Use page parameter with a strict page cap; first page returns up to 30 results.
constraints: Search returns active matching gems and is relevance-ranked, not exhaustive.
Only explicit source_code_uri values on approved repository hosts enter the review queue; homepage URLs are not treated as source repositories.
Registry metadata does not prove source authenticity, quality or safety.

sources.name: NuGet.org public packages
sources.pagination: The service index must be read to discover the current SearchQueryService endpoint. nuget.org documents skip/take limits.
constraints: Search results commonly expose projectUrl, which is not necessarily a source repository URL.
Design a trusted source-repository enrichment step before queueing repositories.
Do not treat NuGet verified-prefix status as a security endorsement.

sources.name: Maven Central public artifacts
sources.authentication: Public search API; no credentials required.
sources.pagination: Use bounded rows/start parameters and conservative request pacing.
constraints: Artifact search metadata does not itself provide a verified source repository URL.
A future integration needs safe POM SCM metadata enrichment and URL validation.
Do not infer repository location from artifact coordinates or homepage links.

sources.name: Packagist public packages
sources.authentication: Anonymous public search; no credentials required.
sources.pagination: Use a strict per_page cap and first page per query; follow returned next links only in future incremental implementations.
constraints: Search is relevance-ranked and not a complete package export.
Only the explicit repository field is considered; package page URL is not a source repository.
Only HTTPS repository URLs on approved source hosts enter the repository review queue.

sources.name: Go module index
sources.pagination: Incremental RFC3339 since cursor; maximum 2,000 records per request.
constraints: Feed reports module paths and versions, not verified source repository URLs.
Module paths may use vanity import domains; do not infer a Git host or repository URL.
A future design must resolve source provenance safely without downloading or executing module code.

sources.name: Hex public packages
sources.authentication: Public package search and metadata; no credentials required for public packages.
sources.pagination: Search API documented; bounded search required.
constraints: Search endpoint is documented, but implementation must verify response schema and a bounded metadata enrichment strategy before activation.
Only explicit source repository links may be accepted; do not treat package homepage as repository.
Never access private repository endpoints or send credentials.

record_requirements: Keep the original source URL and provider identifier.
Record when and how the record was discovered.
Normalize repository URLs before duplicate comparison.
Do not treat missing fields as zero or false.
Queue candidates for human review before adding them to data/projects.json.
